data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2022 Syndicate 6117 had gross claims outstanding of GBP 102.3m. Analysis of the gross claims development table shows a net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 25.7m (c. 25.1% of opening reserves), driven by favourable development on the 2020 underwriting year. The Syndicate predominantly writes short-tail property-catastrophe reinsurance business; the report emphasises catastrophe exposure and reserving assumptions but does not explicitly state a gross prior-year movement figure, so the development has been calculated from the published gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate writes predominately short-tail property-catastrophe business in the US and internationally.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit verbatim statement of a GROSS prior-year reserve movement was found in the narrative. Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle). Only the 2020 underwriting year qualified as 'prior' (excluding 2021 and 2022). The report includes hypothetical RDL scenario loss estimates which were recorded as named events. Confidence in the computed prior-year development is moderate (0.8) because it is derived from the triangle rather than an explicit gross movement note.
